title: Form / Flow weekly plan version 2
description: One weekly plan under 1 MiB. Weekdays must be distinct; session IDs must be unique across the week; occurrence IDs must be unique within a session. At least one exercise is required across all days. Omitted weekdays are rest days. Range maxima must not be less than minima. These semantic checks also run in the app. No field grants medical suitability or executable policy permissions. Alternatives are flat (maximum 6). Interval templates have at most 40 steps per activity and expand to at most 400; the sum of the largest base/alternative expansion for each session occurrence must be at most 2000. Native validation enforces these sum and identity constraints. estimatedMinutes 0 means unknown.

reps.description: The maximum must be greater than or equal to the minimum.

duration.description: The maximum must be greater than or equal to the minimum.

distance.description: The maximum must be greater than or equal to the minimum.

calories.description: The maximum must be greater than or equal to the minimum.

effort.description: The maximum must be greater than or equal to the minimum. Strength uses rir; cardio uses rpe.

policy.description: Informational only. This app preserves the reference for manual review and executes no imported progression policy.

intervals.description: At most 40 template steps and 400 expanded steps across all blocks. Block IDs are unique; step IDs are unique per block. Every block repeats its entire ordered sequence. No nesting.

alternatives.description: Flat alternatives with distinct IDs. No nested alternatives and no inherited progression permission.

estimatedMinutes.description: 0 means duration not specified; positive values are estimates in minutes.
